# GITS — services and evidence

GITS builds websites, business software, automation and integrations for businesses and agencies.

## Custom software development
Build a product or operational system around an agreed workflow. Start with the part that matters most, review it with your team, and expand after it works.
https://www.gits.technology/services/custom-software-development
Starting scope: Agree one user journey, its required inputs, the action it enables and how completion will be checked. The scope can include roles, validation and a simple report where needed. Larger products continue in separate milestones.

## Websites and digital experiences
We design and build websites that help visitors understand your offer and take the next step. Choose a new build, a focused redesign or an improvement to your existing site.
https://www.gits.technology/services/websites-digital-experiences
Starting scope: Start with one agreed page or journey: an enquiry, booking, product request or purchase. Define content, mobile behavior and the submission destination before expanding the scope.

## Internal tools and CRM
Keep leads, approvals, tasks and reports connected in a tool shaped around your operation. We can improve an existing setup or build the missing workflow.
https://www.gits.technology/services/internal-tools-crm
Starting scope: Choose one pipeline, approval queue or recurring report. Agree the users, import format, permissions and completion check before adding more departments or features.

## AI and business automation
Connect AI and automation to an agreed workflow, check the results, and route uncertain cases for human review. Start with a useful task and measure it before expanding.
https://www.gits.technology/services/ai-business-automation
Starting scope: Agree an input, an expected output, a review rule and a small evaluation set. Use the findings to decide whether the workflow is ready for a paid implementation.

## Integrations and APIs
Connect payments, bookings, messages and business tools so your team can follow what happened. Agree the data rules, make failures visible and hand over a system your team can understand.
https://www.gits.technology/services/integrations-apis
Starting scope: Agree the source event, destination record and expected data. Include validation, a recovery path and an acceptance check. Add further systems in separate milestones.

Examples: https://www.gits.technology/what-we-build
Example interfaces use sample data. Client provenance and measured outcomes are not established by a live URL. Do not assert client metrics, team counts, delivery rates or universal starting prices.

Contact: https://www.gits.technology/contact or hello@gits.technology. Pricing, delivery, code access and support are agreed in a scoped proposal. Third-party costs are separate.
Engineering portfolio: https://gwer.space
